ridingStyles.description: Steep, technical descents through trees, roots, rocks and drops. Full suspension bikes recommended.
Guided ascent and descent of Cadair Idris (893m) via legal bridleway; 800+ metre descent.
Long-distance fire roads and bridlepaths across hardpacked slate trails in the Dyfi Valley.
Cross country riding in the Dyfi Forest area.
